feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
entry.summary: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

entry.title: Trump gives primetime speech at GOP convention, promising payout if Republicans win
entry.summary: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.

entry.title: Veteran pollster shares takeaways from Trump's convention speech
entry.summary: Veteran pollster and political consultant Frank Luntz gives an analysis of President Trump's speech at the Republicans' midterm convention.

entry.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
entry.summary: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

entry.title: After Trump promised to pay $5,000 if Republicans win, here's what to expect Thursday
entry.summary: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, setting high expectations for the convention's final night.

entry.title: Missouri clerk on what the battle over the state's electoral maps means for voters
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks Boone County, Missouri, clerk Brianna Lennon what the legal battle over the state's electoral maps means for voters there.

entry.title: Trump gave Natalie Harp and 2 other aides $45,000 as gifts, report says
entry.summary: The Washington Post is reporting that the president gave $45,000 cash gifts to executive assistant Natalie Harp and two other White House aides.

entry.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
entry.summary: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

entry.title: Republicans kick off unconventional midterm convention in Dallas with Trump speech
entry.summary: Republicans' first midterm convention, being touted as a "Trumpapalooza" by the Republican Party chairman, kicks off in Dallas with a program focused heavily on tax cuts and border security.

entry.title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
entry.summary: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.
